flags: AI appears only in the act's relating clause ('relating to Division of Consumer Counsel; duties; artificial intelligence fraud and abuse'); the operative amended text says 'emerging technologies', not 'artificial intelligence'

takedown-process assigned because the bound party (the Division) must establish a complaint-receiving channel; vocabulary duty is usually applied to companies — flagged as a possible stretch
